descriptions.notStarted: I should go check up on Alcaster in El Nath soon.
descriptions.inProgress: Alcaster of El Nath told me in order to seal up the #bBook of Ancient#k, he'll need a #bDark Crystal#k and a #bStar Rock#k. So here I am, looking for those two. The Dark Crystal is supposedly only available through evil-minded monsters, and the ores can be refined through Spiruna of Orbis Park.
descriptions.completed: I got Alcaster the #bDark Crystal#k and the #bStar Rock#k. He may have been drained and exhausted from sealing up the #bBook of Ancient#k, but he seems peaceful at heart
